# vLLM Metal usability cases

Ten hard evidence-backed content cases:2root,2per sub-skill,2integration. Cases complement58 selected pure source assertions; they do not replace native runtime. Integration cases synthesize cross-source lifecycle/ABI/measurement failures because no safe CPU original native test covers that complete combination.

| Case | Area | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| root/import-is-not-backend | vllm-metal | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| root/new-feature-depth | vllm-metal | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/platform-config/boolean-and-aggregate-errors | platform-config | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/platform-config/native-abi-and-mps | platform-config | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/cache-lifecycle/chunk-floor-shortage | cache-lifecycle | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/cache-lifecycle/explicit-cache-and-unsafe-reuse | cache-lifecycle | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/qualification/hybrid-partial-acceptance | qualification | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| sub-skills/qualification/deferred-eviction-and-counts | qualification | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| integration/selector-versus-lazy-native | qualification | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |
| integration/incomplete-accounting | qualification | hard synthetic/source-anchored assertions |

All ten cases have explicit assertions and local resource targets. Each primary route has2difficult cases; integrated cases cross root/platform/cache/qualification. Unmined long-tail features remain gaps, not covered by a generic case. No comparative agent efficacy experiment is claimed.
